name: stage-dtap-zoom
note: S-STAGE-DTAP (operator UAT 2026-08-09 round 6: 'allow default gestures to zoom on the stage view - like double tap to zoom... or tap tap n drag up/down to zoom'). Native zoom is pinned app-wide (user-scalable=no), so the stage supplies the familiar map-app grammar on top of its existing pinch: a clean DOUBLE-TAP on the sheet steps the text scale up a notch (+0.35, manual mode; from the ceiling it wraps back to auto-fit); a double-tap-HOLD-DRAG zooms continuously (drag DOWN grows - the Google Maps convention) and suppresses scroll while active. Synthetic TouchEvents drive the same touchstart/move/end listeners a finger does; --pscale on .pSheet is the applied-scale readout (the one write path). Buttons never zoom (the gesture ignores taps landing on controls).

steps.label: arrange: stage open; record the applied scale and a touch synthesizer on window
act: a clean DOUBLE-TAP on the sheet lyrics area
double-tap STEPPED the text up (applied --pscale grew >= 0.2 over the starting fit)
act: TAP-TAP-DRAG DOWN (the maps one-hand zoom) - seed tap, then tap-hold and drag +120px
the drag zoomed CONTINUOUSLY from the stepped size (grew again, clamped to the legibility max)
